levels.surface: مقسما، مولى عبد الله بن الحارث

notes: «أن ابن جريج، أخبرهم» and «أنه سمع مقسما» name the source the previous link heard from: links (rule 5)
The Qur'anic quotation and the gloss «عن بدر» are not links
«مقسما» is kept with the description «مولى عبد الله بن الحارث» as the text writes it
The Companion ابن عباس is the last link: he is the one who recites the verse (rule 6)
